description: Angular API Null Safety Rules - Detection + Optional Chaining Enhancements

rules.rule: All API responses must be checked for null, undefined, or safely accessed using optional chaining (?.) or nullish coalescing (??).
rules.description: Detect cases where API responses are directly used without checking for null or undefined values. Encourage the use of optional chaining (?.) and nullish coalescing (??) for safe access and default fallback values.

rules.rule: Ensure all async/await API functions use null checks or optional chaining before returning or using data.

rules.rule: All Angular service methods must guard against null/undefined responses or use optional chaining before returning to components.
rules.description: Detect service methods that return API results directly without validation. Service methods should handle null checks or use optional chaining internally before returning data.
rules.brief: Ensure Angular services perform null checks or use ?. / ?? before emitting or returning data to components.
rules.semantic: Promotes defensive programming in Angular services — guaranteeing null safety through validation or modern TS null-handling operators.

rules.rule: All API response parameters must be accessed using optional chaining (?.).
